mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cesin antimicrobial potency is supported by lipid II binding and LTA/cell-wall electrostatic interaction evidence, consistent with inhibition of cell-wall synthesis rather than a generic membrane-disruption claim.
direct_assay_types: dltA deletion/cytochrome c cell-wall charge support

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cesin compared with nisin and nisin(1-22)
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cesin lacks nisin-like membrane pore-forming ability in its natural form despite antimicrobial activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a negative pore-formation finding; it does not support classifying cesin as a pore-forming lantibiotic.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Cesin analogs Cesin NK, Cesin NMK, W/G, R/G, K/G
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Bioengineered analog results support structure-activity context: adding nisin pore-forming domains reduced activity, W4/K21 substitutions reduced activity, and R15G retained/improved selected activity/stability without creating a direct new molecular target claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-only relative activity bars are preserved as qualitative structure-activity support; exact bar heights were not fabricated.
